description: As careers lengthen into people’s 70s and beyond, many organizations are discovering that their most experienced midcareer employees are burning out just as they enter their most critical leadership years. People in their “pivotal 40s” face peak responsibilities, severe time pressure, and limited capacity for reflection at precisely the moment when they most need to rethink their trajectory.
